scope: Standalone figure images; document pagination is checked by the parent workflow
method: All six current PNG files reopened with tools.view_image(detail=original) after regeneration and checked against the current readers, writers and control functions
checks: Text is legible and remains inside image bounds
Arrow paths do not pass through unrelated control boxes
World-model offline supervision is separated from online frozen inference
The pending D2 queue is an independent input to world-model comparison
Candidate sequences preserve two real pending commands and repeat each candidate six times
The recovery exhausted state passes policy actions through instead of claiming an emergency stop
Data entities are conceptual file relations and do not claim a SQL database
The control sequence distinguishes submitted and executed actions
corrections_after_first_review: Replaced unsupported Unicode subscripts with readable plain c0/c1/c2/c3/ck and q0/q1
Rerouted the recovery retry edge below all exception boxes to remove an ambiguous crossing
Reopened candidate_flow.png and recovery_flow.png after their final corrections
current_code_audit_corrections: The world-model diagram explicitly includes candidate commands and the actual D2 queue in online inputs
The readout-head input is the standardized predicted state, not the denormalized output tensor
Ordinary unheld recovery triggers enter RETRACT; NORMAL held-stall alone supplies holding=True and bypasses to LIFT
Retryable timeout and TEST_LIFT failure call start_attempt with default holding=False and return to RETRACT only when another attempt may start
The retry decision tests remaining attempt count; a running second attempt is not marked exhausted immediately
Active recovery outside the workspace bypasses retries and enters EXHAUSTED
Loss during LIFT, CARRY or PLACE while inside the target XY area bypasses retries and enters RELEASE
The recovery figure was increased from 1900x900 to 1900x1085 to keep all three bypass notes at 38 pixels without crossing the main flow
minimum_label_size: 38 pixels at 1900 pixels width, approximately 9.07 points when printed at 16 cm width
